title: SwiftPath
description: SwiftPath is a lightweight and highly optimized mod that makes movement in Minecraft more realistic and immersive. Now, the type of terrain or pavement beneath your feet directly impacts your walking and running speed!
body:
# 🐛 Found a bug?
If you encounter any issues, glitches, or crashes, please report them on our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/3DjPbjEnVk). We'll help you fix it as soon as possible!


# ✨ Main Features:

## ⚡ Road Acceleration (+20% Speed Boost):
Moving on civilized and solid surfaces gives you a noticeable speed boost. It works on:

- Grass Paths (Dirt Path)

- Stone Bricks

- All base overworld stones (Andesite, Diorite, Granite, Deepslate)

- All 16 colors of Concrete

## 🐢 Rough Terrain (-20% Slowness Debuff):
Loose, soft, or natural wilderness materials make running much harder. The slowdown triggers on:

- Mud

- Gravel

- Snow

- Podzol

- All types of Sand (Sand / Red Sand)

- All types of Terracotta

# ⚠️ Notes:

- ## FOV (Field of View)
To prevent annoying screen twitching and zooming when stepping on different types of terrain, SwiftPath completely locks the movement-based FOV modifier to 1.0.
This means that screen distortions from sprinting, Speed, or Slowness potion effects will be disabled. This ensures a perfectly smooth and stable camera experience!
